title: V5: proposer seal deadline scheduler (grid-aligned next_seal, fast poll)
brief: Replace proposer sleep-first seal cadence (sleep(effective_ms) then work) with variant C: short poll interval (default 10ms) until wall-clock deadline, grid-aligned next_seal_time_ms on nominal interval boundaries (e.g. bph=3600 → second boundaries). On a loaded cluster the 10ms sleep often fires only a few times per second or not at all (work/deadline-bound). Compute next_seal_time_ms immediately before seal (not after) so post-seal operational delay does not stack. Failed/suppressed attest paths must NOT advance the deadline — next attempt may occur as soon as gate opens. No new CLI cadence knobs; nominal from genesis blocks_per_hour only.

context.analysis: Orchestrator chat 2026-06-01 — variant C preferred over work-subtract; debug RCA docs/debug/20260531-v5-cy-proposer-quorum-wait-root-cause.md
context.current_code: crates/pwmd/src/lifecycle.rs spawn_seal_loop — tokio::sleep(effective_ms) at loop head; run_cluster_gate fail → continue with full sleep again
owner_invariants: Reliability through simplicity — one scheduler model on proposer, no parallel drift+sleep regulators fighting
Grid pulse: operators see seals on shared second boundaries when nominal divides 1000ms wall grid

scope_roles.attester_follower: unchanged (no local seal loop commit path)
scope_roles.solo_non_cluster: use same deadline scheduler when debug_disable_seal_loop is false (consistent cadence)

constants.note: const in lifecycle.rs; not CLI/env cadence override per V5 owner rule

state.next_seal_time_ms: u64 wall ms (current_time_ms); next grid boundary at/after decision point
state.init: on seal loop start: next_seal_time_ms = align_next_seal_time_ms(now_ms, nominal_ms)

align_next_seal_time_ms.example_bph_3600: now=10035 → next=11000 (start of next second grid)
align_next_seal_time_ms.when_computed: immediately before chain.seal when lease+cluster gates pass and node will attempt commit — not after seal returns
align_next_seal_time_ms.when_committed: only after Ok(seal) — assign next_seal_time_ms = precomputed value

each_iteration: if now_ms >= next_seal_time_ms && allows_chain_progress && lease OK: run cluster gate; if gate OK compute scheduled_next = align_next_seal_time_ms(now_ms, nominal_ms); attempt seal
on seal Ok: next_seal_time_ms = scheduled_next (precomputed); run existing post-seal paths (autosnap, drift log window, stop height)
on seal Err or gate fail or suppression: do NOT change next_seal_time_ms — retry on next poll (may be immediate if still past deadline)
sleep_ms = min(SEAL_POLL_INTERVAL_MS, max(1, next_seal_time_ms.saturating_sub(now_ms))) — under load often 0–few polls/sec
loop_semantics.cluster_gate: poll gate every iteration while past deadline instead of sleeping full nominal between gate checks

drift_envelope.policy: Proposer loop must not use sleep(effective_ms) as primary cadence driver
drift_envelope.seal_cadence_drift: Keep 100-block window log (actual vs expected wall over blocks) for operator soak; do not mutate poll interval or next_seal grid from drift adjust — avoid dual regulators. If effective_ms unused, remove its mutation on proposer path or document dead field until cleanup slice.

non_goals: Change blocks_per_hour, quorum k/n, attest_timeout formula

acceptance_criteria: Proposer seal loop uses deadline + SEAL_POLL_INTERVAL_MS poll; no sleep(nominal_ms) at loop head
align_next_seal_time_ms unit tests: bph=3600 grid; edge now=0, now=nominal-1
Failed cluster gate / seal Err does not advance next_seal_time_ms (unit or integration test with mocked gate)
Successful seal advances next_seal_time_ms to value computed pre-seal (grid aligned), not now+nominal post-work
Startup/info log line documents scheduler mode: poll_ms, nominal_ms, grid alignment note
docs/runbooks/v5-cy-cluster-precloseout-soak.md: seal cadence row updated (deadline grid, suppression expectations after heartbeat-align)
cargo test -p pwmd --lib lifecycle (existing + new tests)
CY live (operator): inter-seal wall deltas cluster near 1.0s boundaries; suppression_pct low when heartbeat aligned; no regression on envelope_pct owner invariant
operator_verify: CY proposer+attester up; grep sealed height timestamps / seal_cadence / seal_suppression_summary 3–5 min — blocks/sec ~1, suppression low, seal times align to second ticks

delegation.invite_note:
V5 PROPOSER SEAL DEADLINE SCHEDULER (variant C) — pwm-coding.

Replace sleep-first proposer loop in lifecycle.rs spawn_seal_loop with:
- SEAL_POLL_INTERVAL_MS=10 const poll until wall now >= next_seal_time_ms
- align_next_seal_time_ms: next = ((now/nominal)+1)*nominal from seal_interval_ms(bph)
- Compute scheduled next ONLY immediately before seal attempt (gates OK); commit to next_seal_time_ms only on Ok(seal)
- Gate fail / seal Err: do NOT advance deadline (retry sooner)
- Loaded cluster: often few or zero 10ms sleeps per second
- Do not use effective_ms sleep as cadence driver; keep 100-block drift as log-only if useful

Depends: heartbeat-align on CY. Tests + runbook. Then pwm-review.
